description: Optional SDD and TDD composition; adapt paths to the project's native tools.

nodes.title: Behavior specification
nodes.acceptance: Observable behavior, failure cases and exclusions agree with goal.md. If an SDD tool is selected, point this node to its original files.

recipe.instructions: Use the project's selected specification method, or a minimal plain-language specification when no tool is selected.

nodes.title: Executable behavior tests
nodes.acceptance: Tests observe the requested behavior and meaningful failures without mirroring implementation.

recipe.instructions: Write focused acceptance tests in the project's native test framework; adjust this template's default Node paths if needed.

nodes.title: Expected initial failure
nodes.acceptance: Inspect the raw output: failure must come from the absent behavior, not a syntax, import or environment error. Exit code 1 alone cannot prove a valid red step.

recipe.instructions: Run the tests before implementation and retain their real exit code, stdout and stderr. Diagnose the failing assertion.

nodes.title: Implemented behavior
nodes.acceptance: The implementation satisfies the specification while preserving the existing behavior that the task did not change.

recipe.instructions: Implement the specified behavior using the existing project's structure.

nodes.title: Behavior verification
nodes.acceptance: The relevant tests actually ran and passed. Inspect skipped tests and unresolved environmental gaps.

recipe.instructions: Run the focused tests and retain raw stdout, stderr and exit code. Investigate failures before choosing the next repair.

nodes.title: Delivery and limitations
nodes.acceptance: Explain the resulting behavior, usable entrypoint, relevant test evidence and any remaining limitations against the goal.

recipe.instructions: Read the actual implementation and test output, then deliver the result in the project's usual form.
